2. Type the lifted output as the `ListViewExportOptions` PR #4584 landed in @object-ui/types — one spelling of the five-key shape, no third copy.
3. 4. Residue noted, not built: when the spec pin bumps past #8324, an equivalence test (bridge lift === spec parse output) becomes possible — record the intent in the test header; do not block on it.
5. Changeset: '@object-ui/react' per its measured .d.ts (the bridge is internal — expected patch; if the node type surface moves, grade with reasoning). Never major.

**Sequencing:** gate worktree creation on PR #4584 reaching origin/main (armed on green CI — the type you consume lands there). **Mutual exclusion:** ⛔ #4550 in flight owns packages/react's navigation files (disjoint — spec-bridge only for you); #4576 in flight owns core/i18n number policy (disjoint).
